messages.english: Record elevation benchmarks separately from the terrain model in your site survey.
messages.translation: Rekota matshwao a bophahamo ka thoko ho mohlala wa sebaka patlisisong ya hao ya setsha.

messages.english: Fetch a solar reference and record wind evidence with its height and source.
messages.translation: Fumana tšupiso ya letsatsi mme o rekote bopaki ba moya le bophahamo ba wona le mohlodi.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Land & Location
messages.translation: Setsha sa hao → Patlisiso ya setsha → Mobu le Sebaka

messages.english: Open your site survey to check the terrain reference and add a separately sourced elevation benchmark.
messages.translation: Bula patlisiso ya hao ya setsha ho hlahloba tšupiso ya sebaka le ho eketsa letshwao la bophahamo le tswang mohloding o ka thoko.

messages.english: Your site → Site survey → Resources & Inputs
messages.translation: Setsha sa hao → Patlisiso ya setsha → Mehlodi le Tse Kenywang

messages.english: Review the reference solar assumptions and record wind height, source and period before saving.
messages.translation: Hlahloba mehopolo ya tšupiso ya letsatsi mme o rekote bophahamo ba moya, mohlodi le nako pele o boloka.
